oracle.derivation: ngspice-45 manual 3.3.1 eq. 3.1: Rnom = VALUE*scale/m, Racnom = ac*scale/m; 3.3.2 eq. 3.3: Rnom = RSH (l - SHORT)/(w - NARROW). DC and transient: R1 = R2 = 10k, R3 = 1000*11u/(2u - 1u) = 11k, R4 = 10k/2, R5 = 10*1k; AC: 10k, 5k, 2.5k, 5k/2, 5*1k. Every branch sits across v(1): i(vrk) = v(1)/Rk, i(vin) = -sum. Transient v(1) = sin(2 pi 100MEG (t - 1n)) for t > 1n, 0 before. The previous oracle, an ngspice-44.2 run, had i(vr3) = 0 at DC and in transient: ngspice divides by w - 2*NARROW = 0, not by the manual's w - NARROW, and opens the resistor. Xyce 7.10.0 reads (l - NARROW)/(w - NARROW) = 10k (the SPICE3 reading) and rejects ac= and scale=.
